description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts (support+NEI); one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: MT binding domain drives amyloid structure formation.
Claim 2: β-sheet opening occurs during pleurotolysin pore formation.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports it, contradicts it, or does not give enough information to decide. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED', 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED' or 'Claim N: NOT ENOUGH INFO'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: MT binding domain drives amyloid structure formation.
β-sheet opening occurs during pleurotolysin pore formation.
rationale: The major conformational changes in PlyB are a ∼70° opening of the bent and distorted central β-sheet of the MACPF domain, accompanied by extrusion and refolding of two α-helical regions into transmembrane β-hairpins (TMH1 and TMH2).

claim_1_verdict.claim: MT binding domain drives amyloid structure formation.

claim_2_verdict.claim: β-sheet opening occurs during pleurotolysin pore formation.
